test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). E is to the immediate left of B. C is the immediate neighbour of A and E. Some persons are to the right of F. D is not at any of the end of the row. Who are sitting at the extreme ends of the row?
solution:
6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order).

1. E is to the immediate left of B.

2. C is the immediate neighbour of A and E.

3. Some persons are to the right of F.

4. D is not at any of the end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/881602f7f7a218ed1bb9e85c8ee3c5b221261d50088a417024e1e20629a4546e.png] 

F and B are sitting at the extreme ends of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
